g.text: Figure A1: every run of the thinking-budget round

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: round one, 18 cells by 8 tasks; one task passes in every cell and one fails in every locally

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: served cell, so neither can move a paired comparison

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: 97 of 144 runs passed every hidden test of their task. A cell is one model at one thinking budget; a

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: column is one task under all 18 cells.
